Yukina Grace is an UFS soldier.


Personality
Driven by her hate for demons and desire for revenge for her family. Yukina is rough around the edges, direct. Simple-minded in her pursuit, and sometimes rude and impatient.

Frustrated if she is forced to hold back by her higher ups and that she is looked down upon in these aspects. Otherwise, skillful, loyal and noble as a fighter, which is feared by her enemies. Because of her origin, a civilian in many aspects and lacks the ability for team play and emotional control to hold back her rage and anger. She is known to ignore orders and will rush towards demons in a fury to kill them, regardless of the situation.

She is a friend of Mishea Silkies.

Appearance
She has long brown hair, purple/blue eyes and mechanical body parts.

History
Background
A Human Cyborg, with strength which rivals high level demons.

Aside from his father being a researcher in the UFS, she was born into a normal family and led a normal life. However, one day the family was attacked by demons, her father was killed instantly, and her mother and sister were abused and killed. Yukina herself also faced abused but survived and turned her fear and humiliation into anger, she uses for revenge against the demons.

She joined the UFS, the same facility her father worked at. However, in a certain operation, she was seriously injured by a demon, and she wandered between life and death for a while. She miraculously regained her consciousness and was given a fortified body. Except for her neck, reproductive organs, and womb, her body is mostly mechanical. Her mechanical parts are also covered with artificial muscles and artificial skin, so she looks almost like a normal woman. Yukina miraculously regained her consciousness and now was driven even more.

Yukina, who inherited her father's will, demonstrates the strength of a demon god, and was given a weapon her father used to work on, the Mjolnir making her even stronger. However, since Mjoinir had not been finished as a weapon, if used it requires a recharge time and cannot be used too often.

Timeline TABA
Appears in the event featuring Hayato Private Academy, Carla Cromwell and the Vampire Hunters.

When Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) broke into the Academy after negotiations between Vampire Hunters and Taimanin, to capture Carla. Yukina, broke into the Academy herself without warning and started to attack both the Fuuma Organization and the Vampire Hunters that guarded Carla Cromwell. Willing to kill Kotaro and capture or kill Carla, she was in the end defeated by Azuma, Kotaro, and fully pushed back with further support of Marika Krishna and Carla.

With this mission considered a failure, she was put in charge of a simple observation mission in Japan. Overlooking the cherry blossom picnic, which the UFS suspected could escalate because of multiple factions like the Taimanin and Fuuma Organization being present. When, Yukina spots a fight over the sitting places between Lark Shasha and Yatsu Murasaki, she jumps in and escalates the conflict. However, with the arrival of Mishea Silkies, she is given a new mission from the headquarters and leaves the matter be slightly annoyed that she cannot fight the demon.

Timeline RPGX
Appears as unit recruitable unit for the Independent Rangers.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Mjolnir (Hammer)

Lightning Powered Hammer: Can not be used multiple times in a row. By linking it with a reinforced cyborg body and touching the hammer and body, frictional electrification is generated, and a boost is applied within the hammer to generate lightning. When a hammer is struck on the ground in that state, an extremely high voltage and current of 1 billion volts and 500,000 amperes, similar to a lightning strike, spreads to a diameter of 100m with Yukina in the center, destroying everything within that range. Everything else is exposed to extremely high temperatures and completely pulverized by the shock.
Cyborg Body:; High Speed and strength on the upper limit.
